# SPD-073 — Split the collab Edge Function (1230 lines) into flat modules in its function directory

## Brief
Plan: [[docs/spikes/bad-036/server-collab|server-collab spike]] (Sebago, BADS-036).

Proposed: server/supabase/functions/collab/ as 13 flat files, the largest push.ts at about 190; nothing over 250. Four PRs, the first adding tests only, because the integration suite covers 5 of the function's 18 modes and CI starts the stack without the storage service. deno check of today's file reports exactly 3 errors, a mechanical baseline for every PR. Three text-reading tests in collab.test.mjs break on the move, and one schema.test.mjs check silently stops covering collab unless it is pointed at the new files.

Open question for Eric: add the storage service back to the Server integration CI job, or prove the signed-URL paths only in a local replay.

Cross-ticket: [[BAD-038]] (the wrap-completion rule written twice) lands after this split.

Verification: the server-changes skill (local stack on podman, DOCKER_HOST at podman's socket, -x edge-runtime,vector,logflare), deno check at the 3-error baseline, and the Server integration CI check, which fails if the suite skips. Deploys happen only from server-deploy.yml on merge.

**Gate.** Queued until Eric approves the proposed file layout in the spike. Phase 2 does not start before that approval, and an approval that changes the layout is written into the spike's section 4 first.

**Rules for Phase 2, from BAD-036.** Split by responsibility; 250 lines is where a file gets a second look, not a cap, and every file left over 250 is argued in the spike's section 6. Every PR is a pure move: no statement is edited, a bug found on the way is its own ticket, and the spike's behaviour-preservation check (section 8) runs on every PR. The public surface in section 2 is the compatibility contract and does not change. Extraction order follows section 9: shared constants, types and pure utilities first, then state and services, then sub-components or handlers, then the entry file reduced to an orchestrator. Verification is the implementing-changes skill's tier for the files touched, quoted in each PR.

## Size, persona and model decision
Phase 2: one engineer on opus per PR in the spike's section 9, in a worktree on a feat/bad-nnn branch after bash scripts/worktree-init.sh; a reviewer at fable tier (opus while the Fable limit holds) checks each PR's pure-move proof before it lands.
